author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
This is my last map I'll be making for Avicus.








Écharde is a competitive KoTH made for the tournament, in collaboration with Fouled. It is decently sized, and has five hills. This map includes extensive cover, portals, building restrictions, and kill rewards.

Hill Count: 5
Images: http://imgur.com/a/HFFpO
Kill Reward: You spawn with a stick and stone sword. Each kill, you get an iron ingot.
Points for Center Hill: 3
Points for Others: 1
Map Name means Splinter in French.

This world is on build in Vice2 so officials can check it out.
